_provenance: Generated from the bm_prod dump (15-09.sql), schema idp, tables T_STALLS + T_HALL_LAYOUTS. Scale 20 px = 1 unit, verified against the "12sqm" area labels. posX/posZ are the stall centre relative to the hall centre (prod used top-left px). Colour encodes the real booking_status (Booked=red, Available=green, unknown=blue). gateSide is FRONT for every stall: prod stores how many open sides, not which side. No production system was read or written; only the dump file.
